{{Top|leg}}
A '''Thull whistle''' was a device that made a shrill and piercing noise. The noises made by the [[Reeho (bird)|reeho]] were comparable to the output of a Thull whistle.<ref name="BG">{{JournalCite|14|The Breath of Gelgelar}}</ref>
